notes_for_editor: Thin record. tnlandforms gives coordinates and county only. The Waymarking page is cited for its title only: the cache reader returned no body text. A Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune article titled 'Towers protect Lejeune from forest fires' (lejeune.marines.mil, article 512101) appears in search results, and a snippet of it describes two fire towers on the base. The server returns 403 to our reader, so it is not cited; check it by hand or in a later run. tnlandforms also lists 'Fire Tower 2' at 34.58472, -77.39888 in Onslow County (NCT064); no source read links it to Lejeune, but it may be the second base tower. Access is unknown: no source read says whether this tower is inside the base or open to the public, and the story does not encourage a visit. The story text is about 95 words, under the 120-word target. Fact-check 2026-10-21: no factual errors found; a sentence that copied the construction-approval wording from Wikipedia was reworded, and 'Marine Corps base' became 'Marine Corps installation'.
